posts.author: Mole
posts.title: Re: Looting
posts.html: We played Kuro's experiment to start with (obviously, he was the only one with it) and there was already rediculously well-built clans. We got extremely strong and had alot of good gear even with them hounding us. The server was then wiped and even then one of the admins gave out gear to his squad and yet we still became the powerful clan on the server easily. Seriously you're obviously just terrible at hiding. Work out clan patterns, get a gang, hide and then once you have some weak guns, challenge them, catch them off guard, take all there stuff and you become powerful. That's how we did it, it was easy.
